# IDEAgent

> Autonomous coding agent plugin for JetBrains IDEs featuring local RAG indexing, MCP tool integration, multi-agent cross-project coordination (ACP), and an isolated gateway backend.

IDEAgent operates directly inside JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, etc.) to perform autonomous development tasks. Unlike conversational assistants that generate standalone code snippets, IDEAgent investigates the codebase, resolves dependencies, plans multi-step changes, and edits files directly with real-time context synchronization.

## Key Capabilities

- **JetBrains IDE Integration**: Native tool windows for Chat, Composer (autonomous multi-file edits), and Visual Diff inspection.
- **Context Engine**: Real-time symbol indexing and dependency tracking so agents reason on actual project structure without reading files blind.
- **Local RAG Server**: Fast vector retrieval and automated file watching to maintain code embeddings across modifications.
- **Agent Coordination Protocol (ACP)**: Asynchronous communication protocol allowing agents working in separate repositories or on remote machines to coordinate dependencies safely.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Rich ecosystem of built-in and external tools for sandbox execution, project management, and VCS operations.
- **Privacy & Sandbox Isolation**: Granular controls requiring explicit confirmation for destructive operations, Git commits, and container execution.

## Documentation

- [IDEAgent Home](https://ideagent.github.io/): Product overview, key features, screenshot showcase (Chat, Composer, Diff), and installation links.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://ideagent.github.io/pricing.html): Production Release 26.3.0 pricing ($14/mo individual, $20/mo organization with 5% discount on 10+ copies), 30-day free trial on JetBrains Marketplace, and complimentary licenses.
- [Architecture Overview](https://ideagent.github.io/architecture.html): Detailed system architecture diagram and explanation of the JetBrains Plugin, Gateway, Context Engine, and Agent execution loop.
- [Setup Guide](https://ideagent.github.io/setup.html): Complete step-by-step setup guide: JetBrains Marketplace installation, onboarding registration, Docker container orchestration, PyCharm plugin configuration, and new release features.
- [Gateway Setup & Configuration](https://ideagent.github.io/gateway.html): Setup guide for the multi-agent gateway, secure networking, and ACP daemon communication.
- [MCP Tools Reference](https://ideagent.github.io/mcp.html): Full reference for built-in Model Context Protocol tools (context queries, learning management, ACP coordination, and GitHub actions).
- [Server Configuration Reference](https://ideagent.github.io/server_config.html): Gateway configuration files, environment variables, sandbox controls, and security policies.

## Video Tutorials & Channel Context

Official YouTube Channel: [IDEAgent on YouTube (@IDEAgent-PyCharm)](https://www.youtube.com/@IDEAgent-PyCharm)
Live video demonstrations, walkthroughs, and technical context covering production agent workflows:

- [Full Suite Setup Tutorial (MacBook Air Late 2018 i5, 3.7GB RAM)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SoAd_3W2c0I): End-to-end installation tutorial proving the self-hosted stack (PyCharm plugin, Gateway, MPC server, RAG server) operates reliably on constrained hardware. Covers Marketplace installation, container orchestration, rotating Docker access tokens, and IDE connection.
- [Multi-Agent Cross-Project Coordination (ACP)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G5xDWL6ORCk): Real-time demonstration of the Agent Coordination Protocol (ACP) enabling autonomous agents in distinct project repositories to coordinate dependencies asynchronously via turn-based delegation (`acp_request` / `acp_report`) and Human-in-the-Loop approval.
